## Security verdict: PASS

PR #218 at **4762719d68375ddc3fc1c3f97ded6b19b0ba1b2f**, one bounded round under C33/C34. Reviewed the two-file +14/-1 change.

The missing-`pij-rs` fallback uses shell builtins to read stdin literally into an unused variable, then exits successfully (`harness/scripts/claude-message-display-pij.sh:24-30`). Input is never evaluated, emitted or written to disk. EOF/read failure reaches `exit 0`; normal execution and privacy settings are unchanged. No new process launch is present in this fallback; live cost remains the performance verdict's scope.

The regression waits 200 ms before writing, verifies the hook is still waiting, then checks successful completion, empty stdout and no binary calls (`crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs:3110-3133`). This directly covers the premature-exit/broken-pipe path without changing the missing-binary display contract.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None identified in scoped changes | - |

**CI proof:** clean detached worktree HEAD and GitHub/remote heads agree; GitHub reports CLEAN and all five checks successful. Run [42760955125](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42760955125) checked merge `d63cc4c9f3ff478a9f1adb4896795b737a9d166b`, with parents main `7fc31093e8d9d20fb8574a7687293062bf7f9a7d` and this exact head. Rust reports **2,412 passed, 6 skipped**. Successful artifact `13737587971` explicitly lists `display_hook_without_pij_rs_leaves_the_reply_alone` as passed.

Static source review and existing CI only. No local builds/tests, hook execution, real config/credential reads, live probes or product mutations. The author's old/new shell runs were not independently repeated.
